metadata.title: Vintage Blues Poster Collage Album Art

retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered collage of vintage letterpress posters and woodblock typography with a central musician figure and a distressed, aged paper texture.
triggerTerms: aged yellow paper texture with woodblock type

recipe.visualDefinition: A central musician holding a guitar stands before a wall plastered with aged, yellowed concert posters. The top third features a distinct header section with bold, condensed woodblock-style typography on a textured background, separated from the main image by a thin horizontal line.
coreVisualRelationships: Musician as the central focal point against a busy typographic background
Header typography mirroring the weight and style of the background posters
Aged paper texture unifying the foreground and background elements
Vertical and horizontal grid lines created by the poster edges
coreInvariants: Heavy distressed paper texture across all elements
Muted sepia and ochre color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Musician is centered horizontally, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold artist name in the top header section.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top header down to the musician, then outward to the surrounding poster details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with text and imagery to simulate a cluttered wall.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between text and background.

letterConstructionRules: Slightly irregular edges to simulate ink bleed
characterSpecificRedesigns: Italicized main header for dynamic movement
Blocky, squared-off terminals on secondary text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and widths of condensed sans-serifs to mimic different woodblock sets.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed profile of woodblock type.
Offers the varied widths typical of vintage letterpress posters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a collage of aged, yellowed concert posters with a central musician holding a guitar. Apply a heavy distressed paper texture and sepia tone.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, condensed, italicized uppercase text in the top header area using a charcoal ink-bleed effect.

verificationChecks: Is the paper texture consistent across the entire image?
Is the typography condensed and heavy?
Is the color palette limited to ochre, sepia, and charcoal?

postGenerationChecks: Check for woodblock texture on all large text
Ensure the musician is integrated into the lighting of the scene
Verify the header is separated by a clear horizontal division
Confirm all text is uppercase and condensed
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central subject with a background of [Subject-Related] vintage posters, unified by a [Color] aged paper texture and topped with a bold [Font Style] header.
